research_line: isolated Phased1 content-ownership O0, independent of frozen v0.31 coordered bounded-drift court
mechanism: Store one digest-selected base and one independently compressed, indexed, SHA-bound edit program per distinct logical content digest; occurrences reuse the digest. Selected reconstruction touches base plus one program, never every family program.

independent_structural_heldout.regimes: 64B insert, 512B delete, shuffled 512B blocks, shared-prefix with random tail, and unrelated random

filesystem_v1_metadata_bridge.metadata: 32KiB bounded path-range index/chunk codec; none versus independent per-file 1KiB xattrs

create_cost_micro.notes: same synthetic inputs, wall/CPU/RSS tracked separately; different source-equivalent validation work; no product timing credit

strongest_negative: Indexed patches lose to independently compressed content-dedup on all 32 independent/random and high-mutation exploratory cases and all 16 unrelated held-out cases. They also export extra create work, especially on unrelated content, so unconditional candidate construction is unjustified.
scientific_decision: PRESERVE_SCOPED_SEED__NO_PRODUCT_CREDIT; materially changed content ownership defeats the all-patch selective decoded-work obstruction on tested families, but generic cheap admission, full-product economics, native reader, recovery and exact hosted Python-zstandard proof remain unresolved.
counterfactual: The earlier shared-BCD locality negative should not be interpreted as a general impossibility for bounded base+edit representations: independent per-digest patch ownership changes the decoder-visible dependency closure.
authority_boundary: All rows and replay scripts were generated locally and are NOT yet GitHub-hosted; numbers are O0 lower-rung only and must not be claimed as canonical CI, hosted result or release benchmark. The frozen Shifted/Boundary court is unchanged/unexecuted.
